description: Where a calibrated forecaster disagrees most with Polymarket right now: for each open daily-board question matched to a Polymarket market, the oracle probability, 80% interval, market YES price, edge (p − odds), which side looks cheap, base rate, resolution date and a sha256 commitment hash — sorted by |edge|. Cached from the daily board (no LLM, instant); poll it in a loop. Public Brier track record at /v1/oracle/track-record. $0.002/call. Use to list markets where the oracle and market odds disagree most; for one new question use oracle_forecast.
name: polymarket_edge
title: Polymarket edge (oracle vs market)
